description.zh:
加速域名。

多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔，默认查询所有加速域名。
description.en:
The accelerated domain name.

You can specify multiple domain names and separate them with commas (,). If you leave this parameter empty, data for all accelerated domain names is queried.

description.zh:
获取数据的结束时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

> 结束时间需大于起始时间。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

> The end time must be later than the start time.

description.zh:
是否补零。取值：
- **true**：补零。
- **false**：不补零。
description.en:
Specifies whether to pad data with zeros. Valid values:

- **true**: Pads data with zeros.

- **false**: Does not pad data with zeros.

description.zh:
查询数据的时间粒度，单位为秒。

根据您指定**StartTime**和**EndTime**两者的时间跨度，该参数取值如下：

- 3天以内（不包含3天整）：支持**300**、**3600**、 **86400**，如果不传该参数，默认值为**300**。

- 3~31天（不包含31天整）：支持**3600**和**86400**，如果不传该参数，默认值为**3600**。

- 31天及以上：支持**86400**，如果不传该参数，默认值为**86400**。
description.en:
The time granularity of the data to query, in seconds.

The valid values for this parameter depend on the time span between **StartTime** and **EndTime**:

- If the time span is less than 3 days: **300**, **3600**, and **86400** are supported. The default value is **300**.

- If the time span is from 3 to 31 days (exclusive): **3600** and **86400** are supported. The default value is **3600**.

- If the time span is 31 days or more: **86400** is supported. The default value is **86400**.

description.zh:
运营商英文名。

您可以调用[DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~207199~~)接口获取，默认查询所有运营商。
description.en:
The English name of the carrier. You can call the [DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~207199~~) operation to query the English name. If you do not specify this parameter, data for all carriers is queried.

You can call the [DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~207199~~) operation, which queries all carriers by default.

description.zh:
地域商英文名。

您可以调用[DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~207199~~)接口获取，默认查询所有地域。
description.en:
The English name of the region. You can call the [DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~207199~~) operation to query the English name. If you do not specify this parameter, data for all regions is queried.

You can call the [DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~207199~~) operation. By default, all regions are queried.

description.zh:
获取数据的起始时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
description.en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

description.zh: 是否自适应计算**Interval**值，如果**timeMerge**=**1**，会根据**startTime**和**endTime**计算出合适的**inteval**值，和**Interval**参数任选。
description.en: Specifies whether to automatically adjust the time granularity. If you set this parameter to **1**, an appropriate value for the **Interval** parameter is used based on the specified **StartTime** and **EndTime**. You can specify either this parameter or the **Interval** parameter.

title.zh: 获取四层加速的带宽数据

descriptions.zh:
> 
> -  该接口获取数据的单位为：bit/second。
> -  不指定**StartTime**和**EndTime**，默认返回过去24小时的数据；指定**StartTime**和**EndTime**，返回指定起止时间的数据。
> -  单用户调用频率：100次/秒。
descriptions.en:
> - The data is measured in bit/second.
>
> - If you do not specify **StartTime** and **EndTime**, data from the last 24 hours is returned. If you specify **StartTime** and **EndTime**, data in the specified time range is returned.
>
> - The call frequency for a single user is limited to 100 calls per second.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-domain-ipa-bps-data --domain-name example.com --start-time 2017-12-10T20:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-10T21:00:00Z --time-merge 1 --interval 300 --fix-time-gap false --isp-name-en Unicom --location-name-en beijing --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dcdn DescribeDcdnDomainIpaBpsData --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn Unicom --EndTime '2017-12-10T21:00:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --TimeMerge 1 --LocationNameEn beijing --StartTime '2017-12-10T20:00:00Z' --FixTimeGap false --Interval 300
